description: This file is an HTML document that provides the frontend interface for a database visualizer application, including layout, styling, and client-side scripting to interact with backend APIs for browsing databases, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables and loads those tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cells for table data, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content for long strings or objects.
